observations: With MAP = 60 + (90−60)/3 = 70 mm Hg and SVR = 35 mm Hg·min/L, cardiac output is approximately 2.0 L/min assuming negligible CVP.
At heart rate 100/min, stroke volume is 20 mL; with end-systolic volume 80 mL, end-diastolic volume is 100 mL and EF is 20%.
